artworks.title: Cliffs along the Normandy Coast
artworks.medium: black chalk with stumping, erasure, and scratching out on white prepared wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged coastline with steep cliffs on the right side extending towards the center. The horizon is low, where the sky meets the sea, with a few sailing vessels in the distance. The cliffs guide the eye towards the horizon. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting the cliffs' texture against the water. The color palette includes monochrome shades from black to gray and white. In the foreground, the shoreline curves near us, bordered by the sea. The background has a sky with soft clouds, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Lot and His Daughters
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene featuring a castle and a group of three individuals seated under a tree. The scene depicts a large castle with various towers and structures in the background, set amidst foliage. The foreground shows three individuals, with one holding a jug. The clothing and surrounding elements are detailed, such as trees with curving branches and fluffy clouds, typical of medieval to Renaissance artworks. The composition combines architectural grandeur with intimate human interaction, surrounded by a detailed natural setting.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.artist: Andrea Meldolla, called Schiavone, after Titian
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of warriors engaged in a confrontation. The image features multiple figures armed with spears and shields. One central figure is seated on steps, surrounded by other figures in action. The figures have exaggerated muscles and detailed facial expressions. The background includes architectural elements like columns and arches, with rays of light shining down from above. The artwork is composed of intricate black and white lines, similar to classical engravings or woodcut illustrations.

artworks.title: Little Good Harbor, Maine
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund and R. K. Mellon Family Foundation

artworks.title: Willard Dryden Paddock
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund and R. K. Mellon Family Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man in profile, facing towards the right. He stands in a relaxed position, holding a painter's palette and a painting knife in his hands. The man has medium-length hair that is neatly combed back, and he sports a full beard. His facial features are not fully visible, but he appears focused on his work. He is wearing a coat over a collared shirt. The background seems to depict a subdued and serene landscape painting with a body of water and distant vegetation. The overall tone of the image is muted.

artworks.title: Rose Pastor Stokes
artworks.description: This grayscale photograph depicts a woman standing on a rocky surface near water. She has long, wavy hair and is wearing a long dress. She is in the center of the photograph, facing the right, and her hair and her dress seem to be blown backwards towards the left. Her features are hazy, and her hands seem to be behind her back. The background shows flat gray water and scattered dark rocks. The sky above is a gray color similar to the color of the water.

artworks.title: Mrs. White - In the Studio
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund and R. K. Mellon Family Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with their hands clasped on their lap. The individual has delicate features and short hair styled away from the face. They are wearing a long, flowing garment with lace details on the sleeves and a high collar. A long necklace with a cross pendant hangs around their neck. In the background, there is a framed artwork on a wall and some plants in a shadowed corner. The lighting is soft and subdued.

artworks.title: Fury
artworks.artist: Gian Jacopo Caraglio after Rosso Fiorentino

artworks.title: Five Men Fighting Beasts
artworks.artist: Master of the Die after Giulio Romano
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 28 x 42 cm (11 x 16 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle between humans and lions in an ancient setting. The scene shows muscular male figures in minimal clothing fighting three lions. The humans wield weapons like swords and clubs as they combat the lions. The lions are depicted with powerful bodies and fierce expressions. In the background are large trees and a more civilized scene with buildings. The drawing is shaded to give a three-dimensional quality and highlight the tension and movement in the scene.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks in ochre and black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of various figures in classical attire, shown with dynamic poses and gestures. The foreground includes a muscular figure with a sword among other people. The background has architectural elements and more figures, including one seated on a ledge. An ethereal form, possibly representing an angelic figure, flies above the group. The composition features movement and interaction among the figures within an architectural setting, reminiscent of Italian Renaissance artists like Giulio Romano.

artworks.title: Jupiter Bringing Water of the Styx to Psyche
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 20.3 x 39 cm (8 x 15 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting mythical creatures, clouds, and a person draped in flowing robes. The central figure is perched above creatures like a large eagle, a serpentine dragon, and other winged beasts. The figure holds an urn or vessel and is surrounded by clouds. The composition features intricate linework and contrasts smooth cloud curves with textured feather and scale patterns. The drawing embodies elements associated with mythical and allegorical themes in classical art.

artworks.title: The Chariot of Diana
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.8 x 38.9 cm (11 3/4 x 15 5/16 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.description: This is an image of a chariot being pulled through the clouds. The chariot is drawn by dogs and there are figures inside the chariot, accompanied by another figure wearing a helmet and armor. The background shows a bright celestial body casting light on the scene, while below the clouds, a detailed landscape with a town or city is visible. The overall composition is framed within an oval shape.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 31.8 x 49.8 cm (12 1/2 x 19 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of numerous figures in classical robes engaged in discussion or gesture on a raised platform flanked by grand columns. The intricate hatching and shading create depth and detail, enhancing the textures of the figures' clothing and architectural elements. Ornate buildings in the background suggest a historical or mythological setting. Other figures stand around the focal group and contribute to the scene's complexity. Strong contrasts between light and dark emphasize the sculpture-like qualities of the figures and surroundings.

artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.artist: Battista Angolo del Moro, after Andrea Meldolla, called Schiavone
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 27.1 x 20.2 cm (10 11/16 x 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an outdoor setting with a dramatic sky. The drawing depicts a gathering of figures under a large tree, with a prominent figure standing to one side draped in flowing garments. The sky is filled with stylized clouds that add to the dramatic effect of the scene. The figures appear to be engaged in a shared activity or event, with some figures kneeling on the ground and others standing or leaning forward in attention. The background features mountainous contours which add depth to the scene. The shading and line work show a high level of detail, emphasizing the folds in the garments, the texture of the tree bark, and the expressions and interactions between the figures.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 30.9 x 20 cm (12 3/16 x 7 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure stepping out of an ornate tomb. The figure is standing on a rectangular sarcophagus with intricate detailing, surrounded by clouds and shading in the background. Below the sarcophagus are armored figures with shields and helmets, along with a bearded figure holding a scroll or book in the foreground. The drawing has strong contrasts and dynamic lines, creating a dramatic yet controlled composition.

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 32.4 x 25.1 cm (12 3/4 x 9 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays four figures in a classical and ornate indoor scene. On the left, a kneeling woman extends her hands towards the center. On the right, a seated woman holds a baby, while another child lies beside her. The setting includes drapery, a patterned floor, columns, and a background with mountains, a sun, and a large opening or window.

artworks.title: The Setting of the Sun with Chariots of Apollo and Diana
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 53.7 x 23.9 cm (21 1/8 x 9 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a dynamic chariot being pulled by two powerful horses. The horses have intense musculature and flowing manes, conveying a sense of movement and energy. The chariot is ornately designed, and light emanates around it, creating an aura of energy and drama. Above the chariot, rays of light come from a circular celestial form, adding a radiant effect to the composition. The drawing uses intricate lines and shading techniques to enhance the drama and depth of the scene.

artworks.title: The Conquest of Ignorance
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 28.7 x 42.5 cm (11 5/16 x 16 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures and architectural elements. The scene contains various figures, some seated, others standing, captured in dynamic poses. The figures are muscular, with exaggerated gestures. They appear to be reacting to a central figure advancing through a large archway in the background holding a sword. The attire of the figures suggests antiquity, with flowing drapery and classical robes. Architectural columns and a pediment frame the figure in the background. The use of shading captures the play of light and shadow, adding to the intense atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Perseus
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in black and blue on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure in elaborate armor and helmet holding a sword and cluster of grapes, standing triumphantly over a beast-like creature. The background includes swirling clouds and ancient ruins. The color palette consists of blues and earth tones, with dynamic and intricate lines, reminiscent of the style of Hendrik Goltzius.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.artist: Orazio de Santis after Pompeo Cesura
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a central, reclining figure. The composition features multiple figures gathered around the central figure. The central figure appears to be reclined and draped with a cloth. The surrounding figures are in varied poses. The drawing style is intricate, employing strong lines and a chiaroscuro effect. The depiction utilizes a classic style echoing techniques from artists of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 17.5 x 25.9 cm (6 7/8 x 10 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of three human figures and a horse in a natural setting. In the foreground, a woman is seated, depicted from the waist up, breastfeeding a child. She has an elaborate hairstyle with curls framing her face. The woman is wearing a robe with flowing folds. Next to her is a bearded man with curly hair, shown from the waist up, resting his head on one hand. Nearby, a horse is depicted from the side, lowering its head to drink from a reflective body of water. The background is filled with dense foliage, various plants, trees, and a distant mountainous landscape. The etching is signed with the text “Procacini” on a sign attached to a tree trunk on the left side of the image. Cross-hatching adds depth and texture to the composition.

artworks.title: Nude Man Blowing a Conch
artworks.medium: etching and engraving printed in sanguine on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back to the viewer. The person is holding and playing a large curved horn. Their head is turned slightly to the right, and they have short, curly hair. They are draped with a cloth that is tied or wrapped around the body, with a portion billowing outwards. Two dogs are standing next to the person. In the middle distance, two more figures are depicted in a similar posture, with draped clothing. Several other dogs can be seen running across the landscape. The background features an extensive landscape with hills and clouds under a wide-open sky.

artworks.title: Sorrow (Kümmernis)
artworks.medium: drypoint in dark green on laid paper

artworks.title: Diana and Endymion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 15.4 x 9.2 cm (6 1/16 x 3 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. The figure on the right is reclining, with their head resting on their hand. The figure above is leaning towards them with an outstretched hand. The sleeping figure has wavy hair, facial features, and eyes closed. Their upper body is covered with a cloth, leaving one arm exposed. The figure above has wavy hair and appears to be wearing a long garment. They have a serene expression. The background features textured clouds and rays of light from a circular source behind the upper figure. The lower figure is lying on a soft, natural surface.
